تفترسوا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِسُوا (taftarisū) /taf.ta.ri.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# تُفْتَرَسُوا (tuftarasū) /tuf.ta.ra.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
